اشتهيت (form VIII)
# اِشْتَهَيْتُ (ištahaytu) /iʃ.ta.haj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِشْتَهَى (ištahā)
# اِشْتَهَيْتَ (ištahayta) /iʃ.ta.haj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِشْتَهَى (ištahā)
# اِشْتَهَيْتِ (ištahayti) /iʃ.ta.haj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِشْتَهَى (ištahā)
# اُشْتُهِيتُ (uštuhītu) /uʃ.tu.hiː.tu/: first-person singular
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
